pages.text: Allah the Exalted says: ﴿وَلَقَدۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'And We sent Nuh to his people: I am a clear warner to you.' He called them to worship Allah alone, and warned them of the punishment of a painful day.

The chiefs of disbelief among his people denied him and accused him of lying. Allah revealed to him that none of his people would believe except those who had already believed, and commanded him to build the ship, while he was in Allah's keeping and care. So Nuh was building the ship, and whenever a group of the chiefs of his people passed by him, they mocked him.

Then, when the command of Allah came, water gushed out strongly from the oven, a sign that the punishment had come. And Allah commanded Nuh to carry in the ship a male and a female of every kind of animal, and his household except those against whom the word had already gone forth because they did not believe, and those who believed with him. And only a few believed with him.

Nuh said to those who believed with him: ﴿ٱرۡكَبُواْ فِيهَا بِسۡمِ ٱللَّهِ مَجۡرٜىٰهَا وَمُرۡسَىٰهَآۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'Board it; in the name of Allah it sails and in the name of Allah it comes to rest. My Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.' And the ship sailed with them through waves that rose until they were like mountains.

Allah the Exalted says: ﴿وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ ٱبۡنَهُۥ وَكَانَ فِي مَعۡزِلٖ يَٰبُنَيَّ ٱرۡكَب مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُن مَّعَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'And Nuh called out to his son, who was apart: O my son, board with us and do not be with the disbelievers.' His son was in a place where he had kept himself apart from the believers. But his son would not board, and the waves came between them, and he was among those who were drowned.

Then the water went down, and the ship came to rest on Mount al-Judi. Among the lessons of these verses: Nuh (peace be upon him) built the ship as Allah had commanded him, even though the chiefs of his people mocked him. Another is that on that day nothing could protect anyone from the command of Allah except those on whom Allah had mercy. And another is that all we do should be in the name of Allah, as the ship sailed and came to rest in the name of Allah.
